title: Concept: Elastic APM secret token in a response
description: An APM server URL with a secret token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The secret token is full write access to the APM index, so leaking it lets an attacker erase or forge the transactions that prove what a request did.
applicability: Deployments that render an APM server URL with a secret token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The secret token is full write access to the APM index, so leaking it lets an attacker erase or forge the transactions that prove what a request did.
